notes.title: Start new game from VR!
notes.content:
In the latest version of Doodle VR (version 1.3), it is now possible to start a new game directly from VR. No more need to hit the play button using the mouse of the computer. You can simply grab a card and the game will start instantly!

Happy Doodling!

notes.title: New: Pick colors from the paint buckets!
notes.content:
We just launched a new update for DoodleVR that includes a feature that has been requested by many players: Changing colors! 

In the new version of DoodleVR you can quickly change your drawing color by dipping your controller in one of the paint buckets around you. So now you can actually draw that orange orange or colorful rainbow!! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668791/76ef5803bc96321aaab4009ad24290f3591cff34.png[/img]

Have fun!

notes.title: DoodleVR version 1.1 is live! With more languages...
notes.content:
We have just released the first update for DoodleVR! Besides some small changes, the update includes [b]3 new languages[/b] (French, German and Dutch) for both the User Interface of the game and the (1500+) words that you have to draw. Thanks for all the feedback that we have received, we have tried to incorporate as many small fixes into this update as possible. We will keep working on the [b]awesome features[/b] that you have proposed to us and we will keep adding [b]more languages[/b] in future updates.

Have fun!
Amusez-vous!
Viel spaß!
Veel plezier!

notes.title: DoodleVR is released!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that version 1.0 of DoodleVR is released today on Steam! This version includes all main features that are needed for an entertaining and creative local multiplayer (teambuilding) game. In future versions we will add new features, game modes and environments. In the meantime, we will further improve the game based on your feedback and requests. If you would like us to add a specific language, contact us and we will put it on our to-do! In the meantime, you can always work with your own custom words by selecting this as in-game option.

For now, start Doodling with your friends, colleagues or family together. Have fun!
